name: Medina of Marrakesh
description: Marrakesh's walled old city sits beside the Atlas Mountains in Morocco. The Almoravids founded it around 1070, and its red sandstone ramparts earned it the nickname "Red City." Inside, you can wander crowded souks, see the Koutoubiya Mosque, the Saadian Tombs and the Ben Youssef Madrasa, and watch the Jemaa el-Fnaa square turn into an open-air spectacle.
